You are fully cleared to execute a high-intensity session today.

To achieve your 5km running goal, we must immediately correct this deficit by increasing running frequency and specific interval quality.

priority_1.workout_details: Warm-up: 15 minutes of progressive Zone 2 running, finishing with 3x100m strides. Main Set: 5 x 1000 meters at your target 5km pace (Zone 5, heart rate reaching 175-184 bpm) with 2 minutes of active walking/jogging recovery between intervals. Cool-down: 10 minutes of easy jogging in Zone 1/2.
priority_1.reason: This session addresses your primary goal of 5km pace development and directly corrects the acute running volume deficit. Your fully recovered nervous system is ready for this high aerobic strain.

priority_2.session_title: 5-Min Peak Power Builder: VO2max Cycling Intervals
priority_2.workout_details: Warm-up: 15 minutes of progressive spinning, including 2 x 1-minute fast-pedaling efforts (100+ RPM). Main Set: 5 x 4 minutes at 115% FTP (288 Watts, target heart rate >175 bpm) with 4 minutes of very easy recovery spinning (100 Watts) between reps. Cool-down: 10 minutes of progressive spinning down to Zone 1.
priority_2.reason: This targets your specific goal of maximizing 5-minute VO2max power on the bike. It ranks below running only because your cycling volume has already been highly prioritized over the last 3 weeks.

priority_3.session_title: Lower Body Torque & Running Power Development
priority_3.workout_details: Warm-up: 5 minutes of dynamic mobility and bodyweight squats. Main Set: 1) Barbell Back Squats: 4 sets x 5 reps at 80% 1RM (focus on explosive concentric phase). 2) Barbell Romanian Deadlifts: 3 sets x 8 reps (focusing on hamstring torque). 3) Heavy Sandbag Carries (70kg): 4 sets x 40 meters. 4) Hanging Leg Raises: 3 sets x 12 reps.
priority_3.reason: If your joints feel unready for high-impact running intervals, this heavy strength session will build the muscular torque required for both cycling power and running stride efficiency without placing high cardiorespiratory stress on your body.
